verdict.rationale: Yubico provides official desktop SDK (.NET SDK, yubikey-manager), Android (YubiKit) and iOS (yubikit-ios) mobile SDKs, plus python-fido2 and java-webauthn-server libraries, all documented and confirmed live on package registries. missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials on ease of SDK integration, and no official cross-platform (e.g. Flutter/React Native) SDK is mentioned.
